skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply auditing theories, principles, and standards in organizational and auditing processes, and identify new responsibilities of auditors.
Identify and solve problems systematically in the context of changing legal and business environments while explaining the application of auditing principles and standards.
Defend opinions on issues discovered while explaining the application of auditing theories, principles, and standards and propose improvements.
Ensure a balance between social responsibility and professional ethics in accounting and auditing when making judgments and evaluations.
Explain the concepts and functions of auditing, including risk-based auditing approaches and internal controls.
Explain the ethical standards and legal responsibilities of auditors.
Propose solutions to issues identified in the application of auditing principles and standards.
Explain the process of concluding and issuing an audit report.
Apply auditing principles and standards in new auditing areas related to social responsibility.
